'''Frank Nielsen''' is a [[Computer science|computer scientist]] working on computational and [[information geometry]]. He became an [[Lists of fellows of the IEEE|IEEE Fellow]] in 2026 for his "contributions to geometric information theory and information measures".<ref name="IEEE2026Fellows">{{cite web |title=ITSoc Members Elevated to IEEE Fellow in 2026 {{!}} IEEE Information Theory Society |url=https://www.itsoc.org/news/itsoc-members-elevated-ieee-fellow-2026 |website=www.itsoc.org |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=fellow-class-announcement-2026.pdf |url=https://ieee-org.widen.net/s/qqrqr2nrk6/fellow-class-announcement-2026 |website=ieee-org.widen.net |access-date=14 September 2026}}</ref> He received his PhD from [[Université Nice-Sophia-Antipolis]] under the supervision of [[Jean-Daniel Boissonnat]].<ref name=NielsenMathGeneology/>

He is known for his work on [[statistical region merging]],<ref name="StatisticalRegionMerging">{{cite journal |last1=Nock |first1=R. |last2=Nielsen |first2=F. |title=Statistical region merging |journal=IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence |date=November 2004 |volume=26 |issue=11 |pages=1452–1458 |doi=10.1109/TPAMI.2004.110}}</ref> as well as his contributions to information geometry including several introductory writings about the topic.<ref name="ElemInfoGeo">{{cite journal |last1=Nielsen |first1=Frank |title=An Elementary Introduction to Information Geometry |journal=Entropy |date=29 September 2020 |volume=22 |issue=10 |pages=1100 |doi=10.3390/e22101100  |doi-access=free| arxiv=1808.08271}}</ref>

== Books ==
* ''Computational Information Geometry'', 2017, Springer International Publishing AG. {{doi| 10.1007/978-3-319-47058-0}}
* ''A Concise and Practical Introduction to Programming Algorithms in Java'', 2009, Springer London. {{doi| 10.1007/978-1-84882-339-6}}
* ''Introduction to HPC with MPI for Data Science'', 2016, Springer International Publishing Switzerland. {{doi|10.1007/978-3-319-21903-5}}
* ''Matrix Information Geometry'', 2012, Springer Berlin, Heidelberg. {{doi|10.1007/978-3-642-30232-9}}
* ''Visual Computing: Geometry, Graphics, And Vision (Graphics Series)'', 2005, Charles River Media, Inc. {{ISBN| 978-1-58450-427-6}}
